turn.content: The tax on this invoice (649,812) is 12% of the subtotal (5,415,100 × 0.12 = 649,812), not the contractually required 11% (595,661). No other invoices relate to PO-2026-0122, and no issue was raised about quantities or prices. This is a wrong tax rate.
